{"id":"N8ce7bf.04","decision":"client_store","text":"The TT-6200 is a six-quart electric pressure cooker with a rotating bayonet lid and a spring-loaded float valve with a lockout pin. {"id":"N8ce7bf.09","decision":"client_store","text":"Client contacts: communications go to General Counsel Franklin Oyelaran, copied to Delphine Moorcroft in risk management.","tags":[]},
{"id":"N8ce7bf.10","decision":"matter_only","tags":[]},
{"id":"N8ce7bf.11","decision":"client_store","text":"Client reporting preference: reports must be one page showing the exposure range in dollars, status in a few lines, upcoming dates and any decision needed. No narrative memos. The client wants a page each month and after any event that changes the range. The client reports to its CEO and its insurer's claims group.","tags":[]},
{"id":"N8ce7bf.12","decision":"client_store","text":"Client standing instructions: do not speak to the press or to retail partners; do not contact client employees directly; preserve all documents; allow no more than two lawyers at any deposition or hearing; use one associate and one partner for day-to-day work; bill monthly; and report promptly any other claims involving the TT-6200 or related models. The client has promised its largest retail partners advance warning before pulling any product, so counsel must tell the General Counsel at once if a case could lead to that.","tags":[]},
